từ bài toán môi trường đến giải pháp côn: From environmental problems to technological solutions.
chương trình thạc sĩ kỹ thuật môi trường: The Master of Environmental Engineering program at Van Lang connects in-depth knowledge of water, air and solid waste treatment with environmental analysis, assessment and research methods. Students develop the ability to select, improve and propose technology appropriate to real conditions.
hai định hướng ứng dụng và nghiên cứu tạ: Two application and the research tracks create a roadmap suitable to career goals. The applied track focuses on implementing solutions through internships and projects; the research track focuses on topics, dissertations and developing independent research capacity.
danh mục học phần tự chọn mở rộng từ biế: Electives range from climate change, renewable energy and carbon management to modeling, data analysis and artificial intelligence applications. Students select courses according to the curriculum structure, their specialist interests and Faculty advice.
văn bằng tốt nghiệp: thạc sĩ kỹ thuật mô: Degree awarded: Master of Science in Environmental Engineering.

lựa chọn ứng dụng để nâng cao năng lực t: Choose the applied track to strengthen your ability to implement solutions in professional practice, or the research track to develop advanced academic and technological expertise.
kết nối công nghệ xử lý nước thải, kiểm: Connect wastewater treatment technology, air pollution control, solid waste recycling and advanced treatment processes.
các học phần tự chọn tạo cơ hội tiếp cận: Elective modules create opportunities to approach carbon management, green growth, renewable energy, data analysis and AI applications.
kết hợp phân tích môi trường, thực hành: Combine environmental analysis, waste treatment practice, seminars and activities at businesses or oriented in-depth research.
chương trình kết hợp học trực tiếp và họ: The program combines direct learning and blended learning, enhancing practice, experience and professional exchange with scientists and experts. According to the academic plan, students have the opportunity to participate in research with lecturers or access practical activities at businesses.
các chuẩn đầu ra bao quát kiến thức, kỹ: Learning outcomes cover knowledge, skills, autonomy and responsibility. The seven standards apply to both tracks; PLO3 is a separate standard for the research track.

áp dụng các kiến thức chuyên ngành và li: Apply specialized and interdisciplinary knowledge to propose new technology options to increase the efficiency of wastewater, water and solid waste treatment.

cả hai định hướng đều có 60 tín chỉ. địn: Both tracks are 60 credits. Applied learning orientation for 18 months, including a 6-credit specialized internship and a 9-credit capstone project. The research track for 24 months, including a 15-credit research module and a 15-credit thesis. Each track has its own elective structure and completion requirements.
điều kiện riêng khi đăng ký định hướng n: Are There Additional Entry Requirements for the Research Track?

Research-track students must publish at least one journal article in accordance with University regulations before defending their thesis.
